list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Guides in our own words; sources named beside each guide.
sources_note: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026). Official list — Exophase / PSNProfiles. Cross-checked against GTABase and Push Square.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed — everything is single-player. It is the last trophy you will earn, right after A Long Road and the final cleanup.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it unlocks automatically. You cannot miss it — just play the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes the chapter trophies can pop a little late, once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter, so keep playing if it does not appear at once.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically as the story moves on; there is nothing extra to do.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, the gold for the final mission. Play the story through to the credits and finish the last mission — it unlocks on completion.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. It unlocks automatically on completion — just play the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, the airport mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Everything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it is still the longest trophy in the game: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets and 15 of 18 meditations, plus all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, all 42 shooting range golds and all 14 drone races. Use the Roadmap tab's 100% table to track it. The hardest trophy in the game, per PowerPyx.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250. Stunt jumps are marked on the map; bridges and base jumps are the slow part, so fold them into your free-roam cleanup.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it — dip into each and the trophy pops once all nine are ticked.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are several ranges around Leonida, each with its own set of challenges. Gold needs fast, accurate shooting — take your time on the first runs to learn each challenge, then replay for speed; your best medal counts, so a challenge can be retried as often as you like.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Each location has its own drone race and you need first place at all of them. Fly a practice run to learn the gates, then race clean: cutting cleanly through the gates beats raw speed.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each distinct race only counts once — so work through the list rather than repeating your favourite. Races open as you explore; check the map for race markers in each region.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1 and he texts you a fishing spot afterwards — go there, take the challenge and out-fish him. Keep the line tension steady and reel when the fish runs; it is timing, not gear, that wins it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Three video games run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines around Leonida. Pick any one and play it through to the end — you do not need a high score, just a completion.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only. Answer the call when it comes, then follow Andy's missions to the end — the final mission pops the trophy.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure diving strand: 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not worry if he vanishes for a while — his strand comes back and is not missable.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2. Work through Billy's missions until the final one.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which ones — so finish every stranger strand you find and the trophy will come. You can do them all after the story, in free roam.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3. Steal or find each car on the list and deliver it to Randy; the list tells you what he wants next.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason-only, from Chapter 3. Follow Tyrone's missions until the labs are all closed.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first meditation is offered in Chapter 1: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her and accept the optional meditation — it is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it is unclear whether that first one counts toward the 18, because it is not marked as a meditation spot like the others — PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked, so do it to be safe. After that, find the other marked spots in free roam.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason-only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% completion needs anyway, should cover it. Work through Bret's hunting targets as they come.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida — check shops, hidden spots and mission rewards. You only need 3 full sets for the trophy, but 100% completion needs 15, so keep collecting.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — each new spot counts. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the 100 comes naturally.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges out of 80. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and progress stacks up across everything you do. 100% completion needs 70, so this pops on the way — check the Challenges list in the Progress menu to see what is close.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Possible once both characters can roam together, from Chapter 2. Bank jobs give you 4 stars anyway, so try it during one — then break line of sight, hide until the stars fade, and stay out of sight until it pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner along and keep the wanted level alive between them — PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop. Plan a route with three close shops and move fast.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new vehicle you see; car parks, traffic and mission vehicles all count.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx says gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — so pick a gang shootout, trigger Combat Focus with a group in front of you, and drop five before it ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get to the airfield, board a jet at a gate, take off and keep flying until it pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a military tank — PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest. Grab one, drive it out and the trophy is yours. Expect a heavy response, so have an escape route in mind.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this only opens after that mission. Case the store, use the Snap Gun to deal with cameras and guards quietly, take the goods and leave unseen.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. There are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them — you only need 5 for the trophy. Plan each job, grab the vault and get clear before the heat closes in.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts toward this, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier. Either way: crack the truck, take the cash and lose the heat.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 map regions to clear the fog from. A plane is the fastest way: fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in. The last few foggy patches are usually small islands or corners, so sweep the edges last.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this comes on the way. Each gang's operations are marked once you find them; hit one per gang and the trophy pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the exact method yet (PowerPyx, 18 Nov 2026). The description says: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The likeliest reading is to order a drink at a bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view — but the exact spot or trigger is not confirmed, so do not grind for it blindly. Check back when the guides update.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is the method: get a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass. The exact showroom the guides point to is not yet confirmed (PowerPyx, 18 Nov 2026) — any vehicle showroom is the place to try, and the trophy should pop the moment you smash out.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss anything, so it is not missable — clear the operation and grab all three valuables.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress — gyms and workout spots raise strength, so train both characters until each hits the max.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally across a full playthrough — robberies, crimes, stunts and choices all feed the profile counter. Just play and it pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the exact method yet (PowerPyx, 18 Nov 2026). The description says only: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. Do not grind for it blindly — check back when the guides confirm it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact method is not yet confirmed by the guides. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline — keep an eye out for strange lights and unexplained events while exploring, especially at night, and the trophy should follow the questline once it is mapped.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the exact method yet (PowerPyx, 18 Nov 2026). The description says: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Until a guide confirms it, try melee attacks from a moving bike — but do not grind blindly.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills pile up from robberies; the dye pack jammer you need unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission. After that, launder through your fence contacts — it adds up across every robbery, so this comes naturally in the endgame.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest. Just buy what you need as you play — weapons and vehicle upgrades alone will carry most of it — and top up with clothes or tattoos if you are short at the end.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2 and PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000. Buy garages as they appear — you also need the space for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot, so pair the two.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes. Store a vehicle in a garage you own, register it in the app, and repeat until you hit 10.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)
